capabilities: Insert P&ID and electrical standard symbols
Edit DXF files and convert them to Markdown CAD notes
Generate synchronized BOM tables and vector PDFs
extras: Local-first and offline with no telemetry; binary DWG files are only inspected, not edited; licensed AGPL-3.0.
problem: Obsidian has no native way to draw precise engineering schematics with standard symbols, synchronized BOM tables, and DXF/PDF interchange.
summary: Vector CAD plugin for drawing millimeter-precision P&ID and electrical schematics in Markdown notes, with standard symbols, BOM tables, DXF and PDF.
